resources.string: ON YOUR PHONE · STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
Open the saved report in the iPhone companion. Reports show earlier observations; the companion cannot scan nearby Wi-Fi.

The report includes nearby Wi-Fi names, access-point addresses, timestamps, observed settings and the networks you said you can use. These can reveal where you have been. It contains no passwords. A copy is kept temporarily in this app’s private cache. Only share it with a destination you choose. Imported reports are historical observations, not a live iPhone scan or proof of trust.

This report contains fictional demo networks and is labeled as a demo. It includes their names, example access-point addresses and settings, with no real observations or passwords. A copy is kept temporarily in this app’s private cache. Choose where to share it; it does not enable Wi-Fi scanning on an iPhone.
